name: Aditya Birla Capital

name: Edelweiss Financial Services
note: Edelweiss Financial Services is a holding company: its standalone results are the parent's own income (mostly dividends and fees from subsidiaries), not the group's lending businesses.

name: JM Financial
note: JM Financial is a holding company: its standalone results are the parent's own income, not the group's lending subsidiaries.

name: Piramal Finance
note: Piramal Enterprises merged into Piramal Finance in 2025; NSE holds filings for the merged company only from Dec 2025.

name: Shriram Finance
note: Shriram City Union Finance merged into Shriram Transport Finance (renamed Shriram Finance) in December 2022, so growth across FY23 compares the merged company with Shriram Transport alone.
